The factory is fully stocked and ready to be activated. With these new droids we will be unstoppable.|A Neimoidian separatist|<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />}}
The '''Neimoidian droid factory'''<ref name="Exploring Mustafar">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Exploring%20Mustafar&resource=features|text=Exploring Mustafar}}</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|I sort of woke up a psychotic robot and now he has control of a droid factory.|A spacer, to [[Milo Mensix]]|<ref name="SWG:WPWT">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Wrong Place, Wrong Time|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatists]] discovered the wreckage of an ancient [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|Old Republic cruiser]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWG:ORC">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=loading|Old Republic Cruiser|Mustafar}}</ref> The only occupant of the ship was the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]]. The Neimoidian [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] who examined the droid soon realized that HK-47's technology was superior than anything they knew. Since they were unable to perform a memory wipe, they transferred the memory and thought patterns of the droid into a sub-system of the crashed cruiser in order to study the technology of the droid. [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] then ordered the construction of a droid factory on Mustafar in order to produce an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] based on HK-47's technology. The new droid model developed by the Separatists included new [[HK-series assassin droid|HK-series droids]], such as the [[HK-57]] and [[HK-67]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> and the larger [[Union Sentry Droid]]s.<ref name="SWG:USD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=loading|Union Sentry Droid|Mustafar}}</ref>

Unfortunately for the Separatists, the construction of a droid factory was only achieved in the last days of the Clone Wars. Viceroy Gunray and the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] were [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|killed]] just before the factory was activated. As the Clone Wars ended, the Neimoidian separatists fled Mustafar to avoid the retaliation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and abandoned the facility.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> Only a small detachment of defense droids remained in the factory.<ref name="SWG:WPWT" /> After the Clone Wars, the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] indeed tried to explore the factory but they soon gave up because no one who had entered the factory had ever come back.<ref name="SWG:TBFM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for the [[Mensix Mining Company]] explored the crashed Old Republic cruiser and conversed with HK-47, still trapped in a computer of the destroyed ship.<ref name="SWG:TTotA">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Transfer of the AI|Mustafar}}</ref> HK-47 tricked the spacers into helping him to escape the ship's computer. The droid claimed that he could help the Mensix Company if they transferred his memory to the computers of the droid factory. The spacers accepted and headed to the factory. There, they battled the old Separatists droids that defended the facility — [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[blastromech droid]]s, and [[CWW8 Battle Droid|CWW8 combat droids]] — in order to access the central computer. The spacers finally reactivated the facility to allow HK-47 to transfer his AI to the factory.<ref name="SWG:WPWT" />

HK-47 immediately revealed his true nature and soon began to use the factory to produce a large [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]] to destroy all [[Species/Legends|organics]] on the planet.<ref name="SWG:WPWT" /> HK-47's droid army, mostly composed of [[HK-77 assassin droid|HK-77]] droids, later [[Battle of Koseyet|attacked]] the [[Koseyet Mining Camp]]. Although the camp was poorly defended, the droid army was defeated thanks to the intervention of a large groups of spacers hired by [[Milo Mensix]]. As soon as the battle was concluded, the spacers assaulted the droid factory to stop the production of droids. Once again, they had to fight numerous battle droids, including [[HK-58 Aurek]], [[HK-58 Besh]]. Eventually, the spacers destroyed the [[Doom Bringer]] and its [[Hand of doom|hands of doom]] and shut down the facility.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> Yet, the deactivation of the droid factory did not affected HK-47 himself who had transferred his AI from the factory to his original body. HK-47 and the remnants of his army were later defeated in an epic [[Battle in a volcano crater|battle]] in a volcano crater.<ref name="SWG:DH" />

After the conclusion of HK-47's droid revolution, [[Mensix Corp]] took control of the droid factory; with the intention of selling it to the Empire.<ref name="SWG:DH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neimoidian droid factory appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The droid factory was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TBFM" />
